STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_073200.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_073200.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_073200 (
    a,
    b,
    ci,
    LEDG,
    LEDR
);

  //connecnt input LEDR output LEDG
  input [3:0] a, b;  //4-bit input
  input ci;  //carry-in
  output [8:0] LEDR;
  output [4:0] LEDG;

  wire c1, c2, c3, co;  //cout

  wire [3:0] s;  //5-bit output but because of s[4] = co, define 4-bit
  assign LEDR[7:4] = a;
  assign LEDR[3:0] = b;
  assign LEDR[8]   = ci;
  assign LEDG[3:0] = s;
  assign LEDG[4]   = co;  //co = s[4]

  FA F1 (
      a[0],
      b[0],
      ci,
      s[0],
      c1
  );  //cin = ci cout = c1
  FA F2 (
      a[1],
      b[1],
      c1,
      s[1],
      c2
  );  //cin = c1 cout = c2
  FA F3 (
      a[2],
      b[2],
      c2,
      s[2],
      c3
  );  //cin = c2 cout = c3
  FA F4 (
      a[3],
      b[3],
      c3,
      s[3],
      co
  );  //cin = c3 cout = c4

endmodule
